# Executor migration status

Foreman is moving from the self-hosted Executor v1 fork to Executor v2 (`ghcr.io/usefulsoftwareco/executor-selfhost:2.0.0-beta.39`) under ENG-18244; v1 at `https://executor.acquisity.ai` stays up as the rollback until cutover. Earlier September 6 provider-setup blockers are historical and are not treated as current blockers in this implementation.

Foreman's code migration preserves shared triage access regardless of requester, current attended provider write tools, and the separate personal Supermemory connection. Its custom helpers remain in Foreman with their validation, filtering, pagination, provenance, and result contracts; Executor performs their provider calls.

Preview uses the three lane bots (`foreman-root`, `foreman-support`, `foreman-disputes`) at `<EXECUTOR_BASE_URL>/mcp`, with `EXECUTOR_BASE_URL` set to the v2 origin (the Railway domain until cutover; its default is still the v1 host), verified helper operation bindings, and one app-scoped Vercel Connect API-key connector per lane. Production attachment and configuration remain a separate release step. Validate the selected catalog and path-only helper bindings against each lane bot before rollout. Missing configuration returns an unavailable source without falling back to direct provider calls.

See [EXECUTOR-AUDIT.md](./EXECUTOR-AUDIT.md) for the code audit and [EXECUTOR-CONTRACT.md](./EXECUTOR-CONTRACT.md) for provisioning and acceptance. Run `pnpm executor:contract` to print the shared endpoint and required helper operations, and `pnpm executor:readiness --live` with `EXECUTOR_API_TOKEN` and `EXECUTOR_ORGANIZATION` to check installed apps and tools. Preview setup and its remaining acceptance gaps are recorded in [EXECUTOR-PREVIEW.md](./EXECUTOR-PREVIEW.md); they do not establish production readiness.
